name: Mission Wall Sky Size Lock
scope: game-side only: refine the south mission wall for readability, enlarge the Espresso placeholder placement, and make Moon/Mars larger and higher in the night sky
notes: Rebuilt the south About SVR Poker mission wall with larger readable text, shorter wrapped mission blocks, a clearer angel-wing placeholder emblem, and a clean Espresso With Cream placeholder tile.

Made the Moon larger and higher, with a bigger halo so it reads closer while remaining above the skyline.
Made Mars larger and higher in the night sky and pushed it farther behind the skyline.
Preserved all Phase 90 lounge, portal, teleport, Reiki approval placeholder, and private-scene routing locks.
